_schema.check: one of: pocketed_park_z (skip z comparison for Pocketed balls), time (waive the strict |dt| gate for listed events), final_pos (skip the final-position gate for one ball), event_pos (skip the post-state position gate for one event)
_schema.event: single event index the waiver applies to (checks 'time'/'event_pos'), else null
_schema.events: list of event indices the waiver applies to (alternative to 'event'), else null
_schema.ball: ball id the waiver applies to (check 'final_pos'), else null
_schema.bound: for 'time' waivers: the |dt| ceiling [s] still ENFORCED on waived events (a waiver relaxes the strict gate, it never removes the check entirely), else null
_schema.reason: documented model difference justifying the waiver (SC-003)

waivers.reason: Pocket park depth is a bookkeeping convention, not physics: pooltool CanonicalBallPocket parks pocketed balls at z = -pocket.depth (0.08 m for side pockets), pool-core resolve/pocket.rs parks at z = -0.1. x/y agree exactly (both use the pocket center), so z is excluded from position comparisons for Pocketed balls.

pooltool make_kiss positional re-seating drift post first ball-ball contact (event #1): pooltool re-seats each impacting pair to a ~1e-6 m separation (EPS_SPACE) before resolving, while pool-core resolves at the exact quartic contact point and never moves positions. The O(1 um) position difference perturbs post-impact speeds at O(1e-6) relative, and cloth-friction roll durations divide by u_r*g ~ 0.098, amplifying it to O(1e-5..1e-4) s of event-time drift. Measured |dt| = 1.4e-5 s. Final positions meet SC-003's 0.1 mm.

pooltool make_kiss positional re-seating drift post first ball-ball contact (event #1) - same mechanism as straight_pot. Every event from the first post-impact transition on drifts; measured max |dt| = 1.04e-4 s (event #15). All events up to and including the BallBall itself agree within 1 us. Final positions meet SC-003's 0.1 mm.

pooltool make_kiss positional re-seating drift post first ball-ball contact (event #1, amplified through the #2/#3 impact chain) - same mechanism as straight_pot. Measured max |dt| = 7.9e-5 s. Final positions meet SC-003's 0.1 mm.
